title: Space Slug
description: A SPACE SLUG, a humongous worm-like creature living inside an asteroid, seems to spit out the Millennium Falcon and its crew, who had unknowingly sought refuge in its mouth while fleeing Imperial ships (front by Ralph McQuarrie). Though the slug is seen only briefly, Nilo Rodis-Jamero, assistant art director-visual effects, devoted considerable time to giving the model (back) just the right texture and scale to make the fantastic seem real.
